# Configuration options

<!-- generated by `undershell --doc` from src/schema.hpp; tests/test_docs.cpp checks it -->

`~/.config/undershell/config.toml` is applied live when saved. Everything here can
also be changed from the editor's inspector (`undershell msg edit`).

## `[general]`

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grid` | px | `16` | editor snap step |
| `noise_reduction` | 0 – 1 | `0.45` | analyser smoothing (Ryoku's cava used 45) |
| `monstercat` | `true` / `false` | `false` | spread peaks to neighbours |

## Every `[[widget]]`

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text | type name | unique name (used by `msg set/select/remove`) |
| `type` | `visualizer`, `clock`, `now_playing` | `"visualizer"` | |
| `output` | connector (`HDMI-A-1`, `eDP-1`, …) | first output | monitor |
| `x`, `y` | logical px | `0` | position on the output (may hang off an edge) |
| `width`, `height` | logical px | `800` × `240` | box; the design is fitted into it |
| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | pass behind the `wallpaper_depth` foreground |

## `type = "visualizer"`

Ryoku's desktop spectrum.

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | `bars`, `split`, `dots`, `segments`, `wave`, `ribbon`, `curtain`, `line`, `frame`, `radial`, `orb`, `spiral` | `"bars"` | Look |
| `color_mode` | `theme`, `gradient`, `custom` | `"theme"` | Colour |
| `color` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"primary"` | Colour 1 |
| `color2` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"tertiary"` | Colour 2 |
| `bars` | 16 – 128 | `64` | Bands |
| `thickness` | 0.1 – 1 | `0.58` | Thickness |
| `glow` | 0 – 1 | `0.6` | Glow |
| `reflection` | 0 – 0.5 | `0.1` | Reflection |
| `gain` | 0.2 – 3 | `1` | Gain |
| `smoothing` | 0 – 1 | `0.5` | Smoothing |
| `grow` | `up`, `down`, `center`, `left`, `right` | `"up"` | Grow |
| `shape` | `rounded`, `square` | `"rounded"` | Shape |
| `segments` | 3 – 24 | `10` | Segments |
| `peaks` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Peak caps |
| `mirror` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Mirror |
| `idle_wave` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Idle wave |
| `spin` | 0 – 120 | `0` | Spin °/s |
| `opacity` | 0.1 – 1 | `1` | Opacity |
| `fps` | 15 – 144 | `60` | FPS |
| `rotation` | -180 – 180 | `0` | Rotation ° |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Depth |
| `depth_level` | 0 – 100 | `0` | Depth plane (0 = plugin) |
| `layer` | -10 – 10 | `0` | Layer (higher = front) |

## `type = "clock"`

Ryoku's clock faces and date strips.

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `face` | `digital`, `minimal`, `analog`, `flip`, `rings`, `bighour`, `metal`, `goodnight`, `grand`, `column`, `outline`, `banner`, `stacked` | `"digital"` | Face |
| `date` | `none`, `inline`, `badge`, `stacked` | `"inline"` | Date |
| `clock_24h` | `true` / `false` | `true` | 24-hour |
| `seconds` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Seconds |
| `accent` | `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `brand`, `mono`, `custom` | `"primary"` | Accent |
| `accent_color` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"#e2342a"` | Custom accent |
| `ink` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"on_surface"` | Ink |
| `language` | `system`, `en`, `es` | `"system"` | Language |
| `weather` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Weather (metal) |
| `fahrenheit` | `true` / `false` | `false` | Fahrenheit |
| `opacity` | 0.1 – 1 | `1` | Opacity |
| `rotation` | -180 – 180 | `0` | Rotation ° |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Depth |
| `depth_level` | 0 – 100 | `0` | Depth plane (0 = plugin) |
| `layer` | -10 – 10 | `0` | Layer (higher = front) |

## `type = "now_playing"`

Ryoku's now-playing card.

| Key | Values | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plate` | `cover`, `glass`, `none` | `"cover"` | Plate |
| `show_lyrics` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Lyrics |
| `viz` | `bars`, `wave` | `"bars"` | Spectrum |
| `accent_source` | `album`, `theme` | `"album"` | Accent |
| `ink` | palette role (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `on_surface`, …) or `#rrggbb` | `"on_surface"` | Ink |
| `opacity` | 0.1 – 1 | `1` | Opacity |
| `fps` | 15 – 60 | `30` | FPS |
| `rotation` | -180 – 180 | `0` | Rotation ° |
| `depth` | `true` / `false` | `true` | Depth |
| `depth_level` | 0 – 100 | `0` | Depth plane (0 = plugin) |
| `layer` | -10 – 10 | `0` | Layer (higher = front) |
| `music_app` | shell command | `"spotify"` | opened by the corner button (not in the inspector) |
